caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug positioned slightly right of center within a lightly outlined rectangular border on a beige or off-white sheet. The mug is cylindrical with a wider bottom and a narrower top, featuring two horizontal grooves near the upper edge and two at the lower edge. The handle is attached to the left side of the mug, curving outward with a small decorative curl at the bottom attachment. The mug's surface shows reflective highlights and some wrinkled or dented textures, suggesting a metallic material. The drawing is rendered in pencil or graphite, using shades of grey to represent light and shadow, with no added color. The background is plain, showing no other objects or elements.
title: Silver Mug
